selected_leaf: Test the Stage R direct alternative: fuse the publication artifact and consumed-witness marker into one same-store witness-bound compare-and-swap, and determine the exact crash/concurrency scope in which that removes duplicate/loss ambiguity.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Deterministic single-store state machine where the externally visible publication artifact P and consumed-witness marker M are fields of the same durable object, one valid witness W authorizes exactly one transition, the store supports atomic whole-object compare-and-swap from exact predecessor blob b0 to successor blob b1, and fail-stop crash/restart may occur before commit, after commit before acknowledgement/readback, or after readback. No separate external side effect is permitted in this tested scope.

single_atomic_transition.compare: current_blob == b0 and witness_id == W and consumed == false

direct_architecture.publication_identity_rule: The publication artifact is keyed by the same witness identity W inside the atomically replaced object; it is not emitted by a second side-effecting call.

crash_tests.retry_result: Retry may safely re-propose the same b0->b1 transition because neither publication nor consumed marker exists durably.

crash_tests.durable_state: b1 containing both publication artifact and consumed marker
crash_tests.retry_result: A retry using stale predecessor b0 cannot satisfy the compare; after reconstruction b1 already proves W consumed and publication W present, so no second publication is eligible.
Reconstruction observes the completed witness-bound transition and suppresses duplicate publication.

concurrency_test.setup: Two contenders reconstruct the same predecessor b0 and attempt the identical witness-bound transition.
concurrency_test.result: Under atomic CAS semantics at most one contender can replace b0; every stale contender fails the compare and therefore cannot create a second same-store publication artifact.

bounded_leaf_result.observed_transport_fit: The role-local repository write surface accepts an exact current blob SHA as a write precondition and replaces the whole STATE object in one write call; this invocation used that same-store CAS form to durably bind the Stage S result and continuation in one state transition.
sufficient_conditions: publication artifact and consumed marker are committed in the same atomic object/transaction
the compare binds the exact predecessor state and witness identity
publication visibility is the committed artifact itself or derives only from that committed object
retry reconstructs from the durable successor and does not perform an independent side effect
bounded_leaf_result.direct_architecture_conclusion: Within the exact same-store scope, atomic fusion collapses the Stage R ambiguous crash window: a crash leaves either neither effect or both effects, and concurrent stale attempts cannot both commit. This is a valid zero-Work-dependency direct architecture for repository-native publication artifacts.
bounded_leaf_result.unresolved_capability: Generic external non-idempotent targets remain unresolved.
